title: BTT SKR Pico (RP2040, serial UART0, for the ESP32-S3)
description: BIGTREETECH SKR Pico v1.0 with Klipper talking over its UART0 (GPIO0 TX, GPIO1 RX) at 250000 baud instead of USB, so an ESP32-S3 can be wired to it. Flash by copying a .uf2 to the RPI-RP2 drive.
notes: Hardware-tested from 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-20 with the earlier build that still contained the unused segment queue: link, configuration, NeoPixel, thermistors, heaters, PID, TMC2209, motor test and stallGuard. Since 2026-10-25 this preset builds plain Klipper v0.13.0 (the same build minus the unused segment queue); that exact image has not been flashed yet. See docs/HARDWARE_LOG.md.
This firmware does NOT talk over USB. To go back to USB, flash the skr-pico preset again (BOOTSEL + copy).
BOOTSEL: hold the boot button while plugging USB in (or tap RESET while holding it); a drive named RPI-RP2 appears.
Check the TX0/RX0/5V/GND positions on BTT's SKR Pico pinout diagram before wiring; this preset only names the RP2040 pins.
UNVERIFIED: whether your particular SKR Pico revision has a W25Q080 flash chip; this follows Klipper's own SKR Pico config header and defaults.
sources: Klipper v0.13.0 config/generic-bigtreetech-skr-pico-v1.0.cfg (header comments: RP2040, USB, copy out/klipper.uf2 in boot mode)
BIGTREETECH SKR-Pico Klipper/README.md (UART: "Communication Interface: UART0 on GPIO0/GPIO1"; Pi powered from the board +5V)
RP2040 datasheet function table: GPIO0 = UART0 TX, GPIO1 = UART0 RX
serial_uart: UART0 on GPIO0 (TX) / GPIO1 (RX), 250000 baud. Wire SKR Pico TX0 to the ESP32-S3 RX GPIO, SKR Pico RX0 to the ESP32-S3 TX GPIO, and GND to GND. BTT's guide powers a Raspberry Pi from the board's +5V on the same wiring, so the ESP32-S3 5V pin can be fed from there (do not also power the ESP32-S3 over USB at the same time).
tested_on: 2026-10-11, the author: BTT SKR Pico with the shipped build, wired to an ESP32-S3 over UART0. Tested: identify, data dictionary, get_config, Klipper-style config with the on-board NeoPixel (gpio24) switching colour. Not tested: other pins, motion, the segment queue.
